name: reveal
description: A hidden entity here becomes known to the player.

entity_id.description: Exact id of an entity listed as hidden here.

name: enter
description: A cast member comes into the scene.

entity_id.description: Exact id of a cast member not already here.

name: leave
description: A cast member goes out of the scene.

entity_id.description: Exact id of who here died.

name: join_party
description: A character here starts travelling with the player.

entity_id.description: Exact id of who is joining.

name: leave_party
description: A party member stops travelling with the player.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the party member leaving.

name: next_scene
description: Call this with nothing set when the scene reaches a stopping point. Set `pursuit` instead once the player has left this place. Set `complication` instead to bring a new situation down on this place.

pursuit.description: Where the player is going, in their own words. Empty to offer the way on.

complication.description: What arrives or turns here, and why. Empty otherwise.

name: change_tags
description: A character here gains tags, loses tags, or both.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the player or someone here.

kind.description: `gear` for a thing taken or lost. `condition` for a lasting mark such as `Poisoned`.

gained.description: Title-case tags gained, such as `Rusty Key`.

lost.description: Exact tags lost, lifted or used up.

name: drive
description: A living character's goal, motive or nemesis changes.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the player or a living character here.

goal.description: What they now pursue, in one line. Empty keeps the current goal.

motive.description: Why, in one line. Empty keeps the current motive.

nemesis.description: Who or what stands in their way. Empty keeps the current nemesis.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the player or a character here.

name: roll
description: Call this for one closed dramatic question. The engine rolls Chance against Risk, reads the answer, and moves luck in a conflict.

what.description: The attempt, in a few words the player reads.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the character here who acts.

question.description: Closed question where yes means the actor gets what they want. Only you read it.

position.description: Which side the relevant tags and situation favour.

edge.description: Tag or circumstance that sets the position, read by the player. Empty for neutral.

opponent_id.description: Exact id of the character here that resists. Null when nothing fights back.
